name: Environments API
description: Regression tests for the environment endpoints of Requesto's own backend. A stable baseline environment is saved first (so the scratch environment can always be deleted afterwards), then the scratch environment ({{environmentId}}) is created, asserted on, and cleaned up.

requests.name: Save Baseline Environment
requests.documentation:
# Save Baseline Environment

Stores the empty baseline environment (env-baseline) before anything else runs. Restore Active Environment switches back to it at the end of the suite.

requests.name: List Environments
requests.documentation:
# List Environments

Lists the environments in the workspace and asserts the active environment id is present.

requests.name: Save Environment
requests.documentation:
# Save Environment

Saves the test environment with a single token variable. The id comes from {{environmentId}} and must be preserved on save.

requests.name: Export Environment
requests.documentation:
# Export Environment

Exports the test environment and asserts it round-trips, including the token variable.

requests.name: Set Active Environment
requests.documentation:
# Set Active Environment

Marks the test environment as active.

requests.name: Reset Current Values
requests.documentation:
# Reset Current Values

Clears local current-value overrides on the test environment.

requests.name: Delete Environment
requests.documentation:
# Delete Environment

Deletes the test environment once its assertions are done.

requests.name: Restore Active Environment
requests.documentation:
# Restore Active Environment

Switches the active environment back to env-baseline, the baseline saved by the first request.
